name.zh: 二连浩特—广州高速公路

aka.en: Xiangyang–Jingzhou Expressway (part of the Hubei section)
aka.zh: 襄荆高速公路（湖北段的一部分）

tagline.en: From the Mongolian border at Erenhot to the Guangzhou ring road, west of and parallel to G4; the last stretch, a rebuilt section of National Road 208 on the steppe, opened in 2022
tagline.zh: 自二连浩特国门至广州环城高速，在京港澳高速以西与之并行；最后一段——草原上改建的 208 国道——于 2022 年通车

start.en: Shabei interchange on the Guangzhou Ring Expressway, Baiyun District, Guangzhou — kilometre 2,746
start.zh: 广州市白云区沙贝互通，接广州环城高速——2,746 公里处

end.en: The Erenhot border crossing, Xilingol League, Inner Mongolia, at the national gate facing Zamyn-Üüd in Mongolia — kilometre 0
end.zh: 内蒙古锡林郭勒盟二连浩特口岸国门，对面是蒙古国扎门乌德——零公里处

en: G55 is one of the national north–south expressways, running through six provinces from the Mongolian border to the Pearl River delta. From Erenhot it crosses the Inner Mongolian steppe by Saihan Tal and Baiyinchagan to Jining (Ulanqab) and Fengzhen; enters Shanxi at Deshengkou and runs the length of the province by Datong, Huairen, Shanyin, the Yanmen Pass, Yuanping, Xinzhou, Taiyuan, Yushe, Changzhi and Jincheng; drops through the Taihang into Henan at Jiyuan, crosses the Yellow River to Luoyang and continues by Ruyang, Lushan, Nanzhao, Nanyang and Dengzhou. In Hubei it passes Xiangyang, Yicheng, Jingmen and Jingzhou, where it crosses the Yangtze; in Hunan, Lixian, Changde, Anhua, Lianyuan, Shaoyang, Yongzhou, Ningyuan and Lanshan; and in Guangdong, Lianzhou, Lianshan, Huaiji, Guangning, Sihui and Sanshui before reaching Guangzhou.

Chinese Wikipedia's chainage table puts the route at 2,746 km, of which Shanxi has the longest share, 656 km; English Wikipedia, citing an earlier source, gives 2,685 km. For stretches it shares its carriageway with other national routes — G5511 north of Jining, the Taiyuan ring road and G20 around Taiyuan, G36 between Yichuan and Ruyang, G40 around Nanyang. The last 33 km, from Xiaotang in Foshan to Shabei, are the older Guangzhou–Sanshui expressway, taken into G55 under the 2022 national highway plan.
zh: 二广高速是国家高速公路网的南北纵线之一，自中蒙边境到珠江三角洲，途经六个省区。它从二连浩特出发，经赛汉塔拉、白音察干穿越内蒙古草原，到集宁（乌兰察布）、丰镇；在得胜口进入山西，经大同、怀仁、山阴、雁门关、原平、忻州、太原、榆社、长治、晋城纵贯全省；穿太行山在济源进入河南，跨黄河到洛阳，再经汝阳、鲁山、南召、南阳、邓州。在湖北经襄阳、宜城、荆门、荆州，并在荆州跨越长江；在湖南经澧县、常德、安化、涟源、邵阳、永州、宁远、蓝山；在广东经连州、连山、怀集、广宁、四会、三水，抵达广州。
按中文维基百科的里程表，全线 2,746 公里，其中山西境内最长，为 656 公里；英文维基百科依据较早的资料作 2,685 公里。沿途多段与其他国家高速共线：集宁以北与 G5511 集阿高速，太原附近与太原绕城高速及 G20 青银高速，伊川至汝阳与 G36 宁洛高速，南阳附近与 G40 沪陕高速。最后 33 公里，即佛山小塘至沙贝，原为广三高速，因 2022 年《国家公路网规划》纳入 G55。

en: The Jingzhou Yangtze River Bridge, begun on 28 March 1998 and opened on 1 October 2002, was built as the crossing for National Road 207, replacing the Jingzhou car ferry, and now carries G55. Its bridges total 4,397.6 m, and the whole project with approaches 8,841.6 m. Xinhua reported at the opening that the 500 m main span of the north channel, a concrete cable-stayed bridge, was the second-longest of its type in the world, and that the 1,100 m continuous girder over Sanbazhou was the longest in China.

Shanxi's southern end, the 30 km from Jincheng over the Taihang to the Henan border, opened in 2008, is 61.2% bridge and tunnel according to Baidu Baike, with thirteen major bridges and nine tunnels. In Hunan the Yongzhou–Lanshan section crosses the Nanling range, at nearly 2,000 m, through three extra-long tunnels: 4,460 m under Yangming Mountain, 3,130 m under Guanyin Ridge, and 6,350 m under Jiuyi Mountain at the Guangdong border, in karst country full of caves and underground rivers.

Guangdong's Lianzhou–Huaiji section, through the mountains of the north-west of the province, has 86 major bridges totalling 36.4 km and 10 tunnels totalling 36.3 km in 168 km of main line, according to the provincial environment department's acceptance letter.
zh: 荆州长江大桥 1998 年 3 月 28 日动工，2002 年 10 月 1 日通车，原是 207 国道跨越长江的咽喉工程，取代了荆州长江汽车渡口，如今承载 G55。桥梁部分全长 4,397.6 米，含接线的工程总长 8,841.6 米。新华社在通车时报道，北汊通航孔桥为主跨 500 米的混凝土斜拉桥，跨度居同类桥梁世界第二；三八洲连续梁桥连续长度 1,100 米，为国内之最。
山西南端自晋城翻越太行山至晋豫界的 30 公里于 2008 年通车，据百度百科，桥隧占线路总长的 61.2%，有特大桥 13 座、隧道 9 座。湖南永州至蓝山段翻越海拔近 2,000 米的南岭，以三座特长隧道穿山：阳明山隧道 4,460 米、观音岭隧道 3,130 米、湘粤界上的九嶷山隧道 6,350 米；沿线岩溶发育，溶洞暗河众多。
广东连州至怀集段穿行粤西北山区。据广东省生态环境厅的竣工验收意见，168 公里主线上有特大桥、大桥 86 座共 36.4 公里，隧道 10 座共 36.3 公里。

en: The oldest pieces are in Shanxi, where G55 follows the Datong–Yuncheng expressway north of Taiyuan. Its Taiyuan east bypass opened on 27 October 1996, Yuanping–Taiyuan in 1998, and Datong–Taiyuan was complete on 28 October 2003; Changzhi–Jincheng followed in 2004, Taiyuan–Changzhi in 2005 and Jincheng to the Henan border in 2008. In Hubei the 185.4 km Xiangyang–Jingzhou expressway was built in 2001–2004 and Jingzhou–Dongyuemiao in 2003–2006. The Inner Mongolian section from Baiyinchagan through Jining to Fengzhen opened on 22 December 2006.

Hunan was slower. Shaoyang–Yongzhou opened first, in 2009, and Yongzhou–Lanshan on 23 December 2012. Changde–Anhua was begun in 2008, but work stopped across the whole project in 2013 when its original investor's funding collapsed; it restarted on 1 November 2015 and opened on 31 December 2016. Guangdong's Lianzhou–Huaiji section, begun in November 2010, opened on 31 December 2014 and joined Guangdong to Hunan. The last gap between Hubei and Hunan, Dongyuemiao to Juanqiao, opened on 22 March 2017; Hunan's provincial news service called it the only blockage left on the whole road.

At the northern end the first 99.5 km from Erenhot to Saihan Tal were for years the class-I National Road 208, not an expressway. They were rebuilt to expressway standard from May 2020 and opened on 16 December 2022; the Xilingol League government described it as the last section of G55 and said the whole route was now a closed expressway. A year later, on 25 December 2023, a tunnel being dug for the Ulanqab–Datong railway beneath G55 near kilometre 381 in Chahar Right Front Banner collapsed, bringing down the road above; three people in cars on it were killed.
zh: 最早的路段在山西：太原以北，G55 走的是大运高速。其太原东山过境段于 1996 年 10 月 27 日通车，原平至太原段 1998 年通车，大同至太原段于 2003 年 10 月 28 日全线通车；其后长治至晋城段 2004 年、太原至长治段 2005 年、晋城至晋豫界段 2008 年相继建成。湖北境内，185.4 公里的襄荆高速 2001—2004 年建成，荆州至东岳庙段 2003—2006 年建成。内蒙古白音察干经集宁至丰镇段于 2006 年 12 月 22 日通车。

湖南段修得较慢。邵永段最早，2009 年通车；永蓝段 2012 年 12 月 23 日通车。常安段 2008 年开工，但因原投资方资金链断裂，2013 年全面停工，2015 年 11 月 1 日复工，2016 年 12 月 31 日通车。广东连州至怀集段 2010 年 11 月动工，2014 年 12 月 31 日通车，粤湘两省由此接通。湘鄂之间最后的缺口——东岳庙至卷桥段于 2017 年 3 月 22 日通车，湖南媒体称之为全国二广高速唯一的「肠梗阻」。

北端二连浩特至赛汉塔拉的 99.5 公里，多年来一直是 208 国道一级公路，并非高速公路。2020 年 5 月起按高速公路标准改扩建，2022 年 12 月 16 日通车；锡林郭勒盟行政公署称这是二广高速的最后一段，全线由此成为全封闭高速公路。一年后的 2023 年 12 月 25 日，乌大高铁在察右前旗 K381 附近下穿 G55 的隧道施工坍塌，上方路基路面随之塌陷，路过车辆中 3 人死亡。

en: No total has been published. Hunan's section, about 594 km, is put at roughly ¥38.7 billion in Chinese Wikipedia; Guangdong's 168 km Lianzhou–Huaiji section was announced at ¥16.617 billion when it opened in 2014, though the environmental acceptance letter gives the actual investment as ¥14.417 billion. Older sections were far cheaper: the 185.4 km Xiangyang–Jingzhou expressway of 2001–2004 cost ¥4.48 billion, the Jingzhou Yangtze bridge ¥1.258 billion against a budget of ¥1.373 billion.

Money came from several directions. The 145 km Yongzhou–Lanshan section, budgeted at ¥10.792 billion, was financed entirely by a private company, Guangdong Liantai Group. The Erenhot–Saihan Tal rebuild, approved in 2017 at ¥2.491 billion, shows the usual public model: 35% as capital — ¥513 million from the Ministry of Transport's vehicle purchase tax fund and ¥359 million from the Inner Mongolia high-grade highway company — and 65% from domestic bank loans. Its final cost was reported as ¥2.577 billion.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。据中文维基百科，湖南段约 594 公里，总投资约 387 亿元；广东连州至怀集段 168 公里，2014 年通车时公布的总投资约 166.17 亿元，但环保竣工验收意见所列实际总投资为 144.17 亿元。较早的路段便宜得多：2001—2004 年建成的 185.4 公里襄荆高速总投资 44.8 亿元；荆州长江大桥概算 13.73 亿元，实际投资 12.58 亿元。
资金来源各不相同。145 公里的永蓝段概算 107.92 亿元，由民营企业广东省联泰集团独资建设。2017 年批复的二连浩特至赛汉塔拉段改扩建总投资 24.91 亿元，则是常见的公共模式：资本金占 35%，其中交通运输部安排车购税资金 5.13 亿元、内蒙古高等级公路建设开发有限责任公司自筹 3.59 亿元；其余 65% 为国内银行贷款。该段最终报道的总投资为 25.77 亿元。

en: Guangdong's Lianzhou–Huaiji section is designed for 100 to 120 km/h. Its builders said it let drivers between Guangdong and Hunan avoid the old road over Jiuyi Mountain, more than twenty kilometres of steep, winding grades that freeze in winter. The Fengyang exit, just south of the Hunan border, is where Hong Kong and Macau cross-boundary vehicles must leave the expressway, under a 2020 Guangdong public security notice.
zh: 广东连州至怀集段设计时速 100 至 120 公里。建设方称，通车后往来粤湘的车辆可避开九嶷山旧路——二十多公里弯急坡陡的山路，冬季还会结冰。湘粤界以南不远的丰阳出口，按广东省公安厅 2020 年的通告，是港澳入境车辆必须驶离高速公路之处。

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. G55 was built by six provinces as separately financed projects from the 1990s to 2022, and costs are reported per section; sourced section figures are listed below.
why.zh: 未公布全线总造价。G55 由六省区自 1990 年代至 2022 年分项目筹资修建，造价按路段公布；有来源的分段数字列于下方。

value.en: Provincial expressway companies with central vehicle-purchase-tax grants and bank loans, repaid from tolls; Yongzhou–Lanshan wholly by the private Guangdong Liantai Group. Erenhot–Saihan Tal (2017 approval): 35% capital (¥513 million from the Ministry of Transport, ¥359 million from the Inner Mongolia high-grade highway company), 65% domestic bank loans.
value.zh: 各省区高速公路公司出资，辅以中央车购税资金和银行贷款，以通行费偿还；永蓝段由民营企业广东省联泰集团独资建设。二连浩特至赛汉塔拉段（2017 年批复）：资本金 35%（交通运输部车购税 5.13 亿元、内蒙古高等级公路建设开发有限责任公司 3.59 亿元），其余 65% 为国内银行贷款。

figures.source: Xilingol League Development and Reform Commission, on approval 内发改基础字〔2017〕1353号; 9to.com (路桥网), December 2012, on Yongzhou–Lanshan

value.en: About ¥38.7 billion in total. Sections: Lixian–Changde ¥8.336 billion budgeted; Changde–Anhua about ¥5.8 billion; Anhua–Shaoyang ¥8.54 billion budgeted; Shaoyang–Yongzhou ¥5.276 billion budgeted; Yongzhou–Lanshan ¥10.792 billion budgeted.
value.zh: 总投资约 387 亿元。分段：澧常段概算 83.36 亿元；常安段约 58 亿元；安邵段概算 85.4 亿元；邵永段概算 52.76 亿元；永蓝段概算 107.92 亿元。

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 二连浩特—广州高速公路, citing archived Hunan transport department, Ministry of Transport and contractor pages (the ¥38.7 billion total is uncited there); 9to.com (路桥网), December 2012, for Yongzhou–Lanshan

timeline.en: The Taiyuan east bypass of the Datong–Yuncheng expressway, now part of G55, opens on 27 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 27 日，大运高速太原东山过境段通车，今属 G55。

timeline.en: The Jingzhou Yangtze River Bridge opens on 1 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 1 日，荆州长江大桥通车。
10 月 28 日，大运高速大同至太原段全线通车。

timeline.en: The Xiangyang–Jingzhou expressway opens in June.
Baiyinchagan–Jining–Fengzhen in Inner Mongolia opens on 22 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 22 日，内蒙古白音察干—集宁—丰镇段通车。

timeline.en: Yongzhou–Lanshan, over the Nanling, opens on 23 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 23 日，翻越南岭的永蓝段通车。

timeline.en: Work on Changde–Anhua stops after its investor's funding collapses.
timeline.zh: 常安段因原投资方资金链断裂全面停工。

timeline.en: Lianzhou–Huaiji opens on 31 December, joining Guangdong to Hunan.
timeline.zh: 12 月 31 日，连州至怀集段通车，粤湘接通。

timeline.en: Changde–Anhua opens on 31 December after resuming in November 2015.
timeline.zh: 常安段 2015 年 11 月复工，于 12 月 31 日通车。

timeline.en: Dongyuemiao–Juanqiao on the Hubei–Hunan border opens on 22 March.
timeline.zh: 3 月 22 日，湘鄂界东岳庙至卷桥段通车。

timeline.en: Erenhot–Saihan Tal opens as expressway on 16 December, described as the last section.
timeline.zh: 12 月 16 日，二连浩特至赛汉塔拉段按高速公路标准建成通车，被称为二广高速最后一段。

timeline.en: A railway tunnel collapse under the road near Ulanqab on 25 December kills three.
timeline.zh: 12 月 25 日，乌兰察布附近下穿的铁路隧道坍塌致路面塌陷，3 人死亡。
